about: Registry of the simulations whose data is computed once on Kaggle: which files each model writes, and which live pages play them. Only names listed here are ever sent to Kaggle. tools/sims/verify_live.py reads it to check the live site after every run (docs/kaggle-sims.md, step 10).

barton.note: Replaced on the home page by coupled (23 November 2026); kept until the coupled pendulums are verified live.
barton.dataset_subtitle: Barton's pendulums on the Phyein Usul home page: every Kaggle run
barton.dataset_about: A row of pendulums of different lengths driven by one heavy pendulum: resonance, drawn in the margin of the home page.

double_pendulum.about_files: The model writes 108 files dp_<mass><length>_<theta1>.bin and double_pendulum.json; listed here are the two the page loads at its default start (equal masses and rods, 120 and 150 degrees). No page is listed until the page plays the data.

wave_interference2.files_note: Generation 2 of Fig. 1: rings at nodes even in k, blended by the page, every table split into a bottom and a top half. The live check lists the two files every wide screen opens with.

pages.probe: (()=>{const s=window.__simData;if(!s)return {error:'no stored-data loader on the page'};if(s.err)return {error:s.err};if(!s.sha_ok||!s.gen)return {waiting:true};const d=Sim.data.ds;return {sha_ok:s.sha_ok,commit:s.gen.commit,date:s.gen.date,files:s.files,lambda:d.get('lambda'),damp:d.get('damp'),builds:d.get('builds'),renders:d.get('renders')};})()

wave_interference2.dataset_subtitle: Fig. 1 Circular Wave Interference: every Kaggle run behind the page
wave_interference2.dataset_about: Two point sources and the pattern their circular waves make: the field the page draws, computed on Kaggle.

double_pendulum_smoke.about_files: Engine test for GPU runs with large data: one pack in the GitHub release sims-double_pendulum_smoke-<date>, the summary with every fingerprint committed. No page plays it.
double_pendulum_smoke.dataset_subtitle: Fig. 2 Double Pendulum: every Kaggle run behind the page, as the site plays it
double_pendulum_smoke.dataset_about: Two rods, two masses, chaos: the swing computed on Kaggle's GPU with the page's own RK4 (step 1/600 s, 64-bit) for every start the page offers, 20 s each, stored as packs of int16 frames.

double_pendulum_gpu.about_files: Fig. 2 in full: 25 packs (one per mass-length cell) in the GitHub release sims-double_pendulum_gpu-<date>; the summary with every runs file's pack, offset, size and SHA-256 is committed. No page is listed until the page plays it.
double_pendulum_gpu.dataset_subtitle: Fig. 2 Double Pendulum: every Kaggle run behind the page, as the site plays it
double_pendulum_gpu.dataset_about: Two rods, two masses, chaos: the swing computed on Kaggle's GPU with the page's own RK4 (step 1/600 s, 64-bit) for every start the page offers, 20 s each, stored as packs of int16 frames.

spinners.dataset_title: Spinners locked by a rotating field: simulation data
spinners.dataset_subtitle: Rotors in oil locked by a wandering rotating field (Adler and Kuramoto): every Kaggle run
spinners.dataset_about: A lattice of small rotors, each with its own rate, in a rotating magnetic field that wanders over them: those whose rate is near the field's lock to it while it passes (Adler's equation). The scene before the simulations on the Phyein Usul home page, and Fig. 17.
